Shanghai/Ningbo.note: Shanghai Yangshan laden gates resumed 08:00 11 Aug (empties 10:00); Waigaoqiao and domestic areas resumed 02:00 11 Aug (empties 08:00). Ningbo-Zhoushan laden gates resumed 16:00 10 Aug. Over 800 vessels anchored during the storm are re-entering pilotage; yard density 75-90%. SEKO reports berth waits of 5-8 days at Shanghai and 3-5 days at Ningbo. Some forwarder advisories cite worst-case Yangshan berth waits of up to 12 days.
Shanghai/Ningbo.source: SEKO Asia-Pacific Logistics Monitoring Center, 11 Aug 2026 10:00 HKT

Busan.note: JMA forecast track brings Chan-hom to within about 361 km of Busan roughly 22 hours out as it crosses Honshu into the Sea of Japan. Terminal operations normal; no suspension announced.
Busan.source: JMA tropical cyclone specifications feed, issued 11 Aug 2026 14:50 UTC

remarks: Dolphin has weakened to a tropical depression over inland eastern China and is no longer within 600 km of any tracked port.
Shanghai and Ningbo terminal gates are open again; the constraint has shifted from weather to backlog clearance and yard density.
Chan-hom is the only system with a tracked port inside 600 km, and only Busan, at about 361 km on the forecast track.
Yantian, Qingdao and Xiamen are running standard operations; SEKO puts vessel waits at 2-4 days at Shenzhen and 2-3 days at Qingdao.
No MSC customer advisory has been issued for these closures.
